locations.note: In 1927 the Stranger and the dhampir Svetlana infiltrate a village and its castle to recover a relic that would make a vampire immune to its weaknesses.
A train ambushed by werewolves leads the Stranger to the invented town of Redeye, where the dead return from an abandoned mine.
In 1933 the Stranger destroys the factory where Al Capone's gang makes undead gangsters, fighting the enforcer Smiley in a movie theater and the factory.
The last mission: Killian Hammond asks the Stranger to clear his graveyard of zombies and demons, but Killian turns out to be the one summoning them from his mansion.

routes.name: The Stranger
routes.note: From a German village to a graveyard in France.
